use_cases: Create animated glowing backgrounds for hero sections and landing pages
Add ambient color animations to cards and pricing components
Enhance buttons and interactive elements with pulsing glow effects
Provide decorative animated overlays for media and content displays
Create visually striking animated effects for marketing and promotional sections
ai_summary: A versatile animated glow effect component using Framer Motion that creates dynamic gradient animations in multiple modes (rotate, pulse, breathe, colorShift, flowHorizontal, static). Supports customizable colors, blur intensity, scale, and transition timing to create soft, vibrant glowing backgrounds suitable for enhancing cards, buttons, hero sections, and decorative overlays with ambient motion.
